contract_validation_inline_source:
from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util,json,subprocess,copy
R=Path('.').resolve();sp=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('classification_control',R/'scripts/classification.py');m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(sp);sp.loader.exec_module(m)
plan=json.loads((R/'research/classification/PLAN.json').read_text());sources=json.loads((R/plan['source_registry']).read_text());by=m.validate(plan,sources,R,check_inputs=True)
names=set(subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only']).decode().splitlines()+subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard']).decode().splitlines());jobs=sorted(p for p in names if p.startswith('research/classification/jobs/')and p.endswith('.json'));out=[]
for p in jobs:
 d=json.loads((R/p).read_text());tid=d['task_id'];context=by;historical=by[tid]['status']=='done'
 if historical:
  context=copy.deepcopy(by);context[tid]['status']='ready'
 try:m.validate_job(d,context,R);ok=True;error=None
 except Exception as e:ok=False;error=str(e)
 out.append(dict(job=p,task=tid,contract_pass=ok,historical_completed_task_readonly_context=historical,scope='Schema/hash/resource check only; no job run or activation; actual task stays done.'if historical else'Current active job contract only; no mathematics/job run.',error=error))
Path('work/resume-20261107/GATEScut1158.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(dict(total=len(out),passed=sum(v['contract_pass']for v in out),historical_completed_task=sum(v['historical_completed_task_readonly_context']for v in out),failures=[v for v in out if not v['contract_pass']]),indent=2))
